info: MASTER REFERENCE EXPANDED - File 02 - Numbers & Time

words.ja: 合計で二十になります

words.en: Do we only have fifteen left?
words.ja: あと15個しかありませんか？
words.romaji: Ato 15 ko shika ari mase n ka ?
Dare ga ichi i desu ka ?

words.en: Is it on the third floor?

words.ja: 電話番号は何番ですか？
words.romaji: Denwa bangō wa nan ban desu ka ?

words.ja: それは膨大な量ですか？
words.romaji: Sore wa bōdai na ryō desu ka ?

words.en: Is the population nearly three million?
words.ja: 人口はほぼ300万人ですか？
words.romaji: Jinkō wa hobo 300 man nin desu ka ?

words.en: We negotiated a twenty percent discount overall.
words.ja: 全体で二十パーセントの割引を交渉しました
words.romaji: Zentai de nijuu paasento no waribiki wo koushou shimashita

words.en: Their budget is just under half a million.
words.ja: 彼らの予算は五十万弱です
words.romaji: Karera no yosan wa gojuuman jaku desu

words.en: You'll find the office on the twenty-first floor.
words.ja: オフィスは二十一階にあります

words.en: Can you set a reminder for 4 PM?
words.ja: 午後4時にリマインダーを設定できますか？
words.romaji: Gogo 4 ji ni rimaindā o settei deki masu ka ?

words.en: Can we start around quarter past nine?
words.ja: 九時十五分頃に始められますか？
words.romaji: Kuji juugofun goro ni hajimeraremasu ka

words.en: Does the workshop run for forty minutes?
words.ja: ワークショップは40分間ですか？

words.en: Could we push it back to early evening?
words.ja: 夕方早めにずらせますか？
words.romaji: Yūgata hayame ni zurase masu ka ?

words.en: Can I join after my 2 PM appointment ends?
words.ja: 午後2時の約束が終わってから参加できますか？
words.romaji: Gogo 2 ji no yakusoku ga owatte kara sanka deki masu ka ?
Ashita wa nani o shi masu ka ?
Kinō kare ni ai mashi ta .
Kyō wa nani yōbi desu ka ?
Kyō wa dō deshi ta ka ?

words.ja: 私たちは今月出発します
words.romaji: Watashi tachi wa kongetsu shuppatsu shi masu .

words.en: Did you go there last year?
words.ja: 昨年そこに行きましたか？
words.romaji: Sakunen soko ni iki mashi ta ka ?

words.en: What are you doing on Saturday?
words.ja: 土曜日は何をしますか？
words.romaji: Doyōbi wa nani o shi masu ka ?

words.ja: 金曜日は私のお気に入りの日です
words.romaji: Kin'yōbi wa watashi no okiniiri no hi desu .

words.ja: 日曜日は空いていますか？
words.romaji: Nichiyōbi wa ai te i masu ka ?
Watashi no tanjō bi wa 3 tsuki desu .

words.ja: 夏はいつ始まりますか？
words.romaji: Natsu wa i tsu hajimari masu ka ?

words.ja: 私たちは1月に出会いました
words.romaji: Watashi tachi wa 1 tsuki ni deai mashi ta .

words.ja: 好きな季節は何ですか？
words.romaji: Suki na kisetsu wa nani desu ka ?
